Both renderers assert against this.

foldOwnership._: The Actions and Search chips own independent folded panes. Opening one publishes only that pane's retained body; the other remains a folded chip until its own physical press.

actionsPane._rows: One `action.category.<id>` header per category in first-declaration order, then that category's rows as `action.<actionId>` in declaration order — React's TreeDataSection/TreeDataItem ids verbatim (measured: action.category.actions, action.setActiveExample, … on puzzle3dMainTop).

engagementControls._: 🎛️ React's `<Engagement/>` body, top to bottom: the session's `engagement-step` status as a heading, the primary `control`, every `controls` row, the remaining status lines, then the quick-action `ButtonGroup` (🖱️ui/🎯️targets/⚛️react/🟦️.tsx:11004-11045). `EngagementControlView` (:10648) renders each control under `control.id` when the guest names one and under the per-kind fallback below when it does not; a toggle group's and a ring's OPTION rows carry the option's own id, and a numeric control with a unit reads `Label (unit)`.

searchLine._: ✍️ React's `Search` binds four moments on ONE field: `onChange` per keystroke (`applyDraft`), `onSubmit` on Enter with the TRIMMED line, `onAbort` on Escape when no possibles popover is open, and `onRepeatLast` on Space over an empty line while no session is active (`applySearchSpaceAction`, :10512). The retained target produces `Trigger::Submit`/`Abort`/`RepeatLast` beside `Trigger::Change` — the producers this packet added to 🖱️ui/🎯️targets/🧊️wgpu/⚡️events.

searchPane._input: React ids the line by the engagement input's own id, falling back to ui.windowSearch.action for an unnamed or internal one (measured: puzzle3d-engagement).

searchRanking._: React's searchPossibleRankScore: label prefix (3000 − len) > detail prefix (2000 − len) > id prefix (1000 − len) > substring anywhere (500) > no match. Ties keep declaration order.
